title: Pandemonium
statusNote: The N-Gage 2.0 game of 2009, not the original N-Gage card Pandemonium! (2003). It installs and starts; the screen turns to landscape and white, and within a few seconds the emulator stops: RuntimeError: table index is out of bounds, in an HLE dispatch call, after unimplemented system calls 0x2C and 0x2D. The same through the N-Gage application, on Start Game.
